task.summary: Cleaned BT Root* Index. Moved to SK for GC AUX Indexes.
Made rand_query work with empty indexes
Added crud rate limiter for testing.
Changed commit from CAS to fetch_add via SeqCst.
Optimized range iter and fixed update invariant issue. I will transform it into a set of 2 sequential atomic operations. For now, I use a fixed visibility window.
Fix SI for update operations; Divided into two atomic sequential operations, as described in the paper.
Fix SI for update operations; Divided into two atomic sequential operations, as described in the paper.
OLTP clock commit updated, now if a oltp thread moves to reader it will try to correct its local commit
Simplified commit-clock. Now includes reads in row counter to adjust commit-version handle of that worker. The terminate logic now only sets the local commit-version to MAX, indicating exit.
Added OLTP command for concurrent workloads.
Clock now allocates correctly for extended threads.
Clock now allocates correctly for extended threads.
Added clock tid allocation for query tracer
Fix GC lag in blocks; Remove extra latch for SMO
Fix GC lag in blocks; Remove extra latch for SMO
Fix GC lag in blocks; Remove extra latch for SMO
Fix GC on empty Reader threads
Pin Root* for root_live reorg, without actual latching of root_live. Move node tag to single cacheline
Updated overflow count, was set too eager. Its enough to trigger at <= 1 slot left for keys, not <= 3
Rust 2021 -> Rust 2024. Moved page soft commits from Release to Relaxed semanstics, since they always follow by a Release store from the latch.
Cleaned code, and removed atomic type for nodes; GC doesn't require an mfence for reusing a node.
Add YCSB and CH (TPC-C + TPC-H) Q1, Q6, Q4, Q5.
Refine experiments and add plot scripts
